feature.name: Model_Federation
feature.description: Model Federation integrates heterogeneous models, reifies their dependencies, and provides mechanisms for consistent evolution and security management. Trace: [Article_11 §1]

feature.name: Structural
feature.description: Covers the artefacts, links, and structural features of Model Federation, including model composition, graph structure, formalism, domain, and technological context. Trace: [Article_11 §2]

feature.name: Artefacts
feature.description: Artifacts that constitute the federation such as models, repositories and connectors. Trace: [Article_11 §4]

feature.name: Model_Registry
feature.description: Stores all models and related artifacts in a versioned repository. Trace: [Article_11 §4]

feature.name: Sandbox
feature.description: Local copy of the repository for individual modelers to work offline. Trace: [Article_11 §5]

feature.name: Connector
feature.description: Software component that links a specific DSML model to the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §6]

feature.name: Virtual_Model
feature.description: Container for FlexoConcept instances representing federated concepts. Trace: [Article_13 §3]

feature.name: Flexo_Concept
feature.description: Abstract representation of a reified dependency between modelling elements. Trace: [Article_13 §4]

feature.name: Model_Slot
feature.description: Symbolic link to an external model resource used in the concept space. Trace: [Article_13 §5]

feature.name: Type_Aware_Model_Slot
feature.description: Specialized ModelSlot that ensures the linked resource conforms to a given metamodel. Trace: [Article_13 §5]

feature.name: Links
feature.description: Defines reified dependencies and associated security rules. Trace: [Article_11 §3]

feature.name: Dependency_Link
feature.description: Represents a data flow from an output attribute of one model to an input attribute of another. Trace: [Article_11 §8]

feature.name: Security_Rule_Link
feature.description: Attaches a security rule to a dependency link for evaluation upon changes. Trace: [Article_11 §14]

feature.name: Formalism
feature.description: Supported modeling languages and metamodels. Trace: [Article_11 §2]

feature.name: UML
feature.description: General‑purpose modeling language used for structural models. Trace: [Article_11 §24]

feature.name: SysML
feature.description: Extension of UML for systems engineering, used for requirements models. Trace: [Article_11 §24]

feature.name: BPMN
feature.description: Business Process Modeling Notation used for workflow models. Trace: [Article_11 §24]

feature.name: EMF
feature.description: Eclipse Modeling Framework used as the underlying technology for models. Trace: [Article_13 §3]

feature.name: OWL
feature.description: Web Ontology Language used for semantic annotations. Trace: [Article_13 §5]

feature.name: Domain
feature.description: Application domains addressed by the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §1]

feature.name: Security_By_Design
feature.description: Focus on integrating security requirements from early development phases. Trace: [Article_11 §1]

feature.name: Multi_Modeling
feature.description: Handling of heterogeneous models in a coordinated environment. Trace: [Article_11 §2]

feature.name: Technological_Context
feature.description: Infrastructure and adapters enabling federation across tools. Trace: [Article_13 §2]

feature.name: Version_Control_System
feature.description: Manages versions of all artifacts, e.g., Subversion. Trace: [Article_11 §38]

feature.name: Technology_Adapter
feature.description: Adapter that provides ModelSlots for a specific technology (e.g., Excel, Java). Trace: [Article_13 §6]

feature.name: Operational
feature.description: Processes and operations that manipulate federated models. Trace: [Article_11 §3]

feature.name: Process
feature.description: High‑level workflows supported by the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §3]

feature.name: Design_Process
feature.description: Modelers create and annotate individual DSML models. Trace: [Article_11 §13]

feature.name: Change_Detection
feature.description: Detects modifications in any participating model. Trace: [Article_11 §15]

feature.name: Change_Analysis
feature.description: Analyzes impact of detected changes via reified links and security rules. Trace: [Article_11 §16]

feature.name: Consistency_Check
feature.description: Evaluates attribute, constraint, and attribute‑model consistency. Trace: [Article_11 §32]

feature.name: Execution_Planning
feature.description: Computes an ordering of model execution respecting dependencies. Trace: [Article_11 §41]

feature.name: Rollback
feature.description: Restores previous versions of models and tools when inconsistencies arise. Trace: [Article_11 §10]

feature.name: Operation
feature.description: Atomic actions performed on models or attributes. Trace: [Article_11 §4]

feature.name: Data_Exchange
feature.description: Reading and writing of attribute values between models. Trace: [Article_11 §26]

feature.name: Notification
feature.description: Message sent to models when relevant events occur (e.g., constraint violation). Trace: [Article_11 §23]

feature.name: Synchronization
feature.description: Updates sandboxes with the latest repository state. Trace: [Article_11 §25]

feature.name: Version_Management
feature.description: Handles multiple versions of models and tools. Trace: [Article_11 §9]

feature.name: Trigger
feature.description: Conditions that automatically invoke operations. Trace: [Article_11 §4]

feature.name: Model_Change_Trigger
feature.description: Fires when a model is edited, initiating propagation. Trace: [Article_11 §15]

feature.name: Security_Rule_Trigger
feature.description: Evaluates attached security rules after a change propagates. Trace: [Article_11 §14]

feature.name: Intentional
feature.description: Addresses the objectives and goals of Model Federation, such as traceability, consistency assurance, transformation management, composition, and conceptual elicitation. Trace: [Article_11 §1]

feature.name: Objective
feature.description: High‑level purposes of the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §1]

feature.name: Maintain_Consistency
feature.description: Ensure that all models stay synchronized and constraints are respected. Trace: [Article_11 §5]

feature.name: Support_Secure_Evolution
feature.description: Allow models to evolve while preserving security properties. Trace: [Article_11 §2]

feature.name: Enable_Tool_Agnosticism
feature.description: Allow heterogeneous DSMLs and tools to participate without a common language. Trace: [Article_11 §7]

feature.name: Provide_Traceability
feature.description: Link changes in one model to affected elements in others. Trace: [Article_11 §15]

feature.name: Goal
feature.description: Specific measurable targets derived from the objectives. Trace: [Article_11 §5]

feature.name: Attribute_Consistency
feature.description: All attributes are up‑to‑date with respect to their owners. Trace: [Article_11 §32]

feature.name: Constraint_Consistency
feature.description: No attribute violates model‑specific constraints. Trace: [Article_11 §32]

feature.name: Attribute_Model_Consistency
feature.description: Model edits precede any output attribute writes. Trace: [Article_11 §32]

feature.name: Security_Consistency
feature.description: All security rules evaluate to true after change propagation. Trace: [Article_11 §14]

feature.name: Intention
feature.description: Purpose of a particular federation instance (e.g., synchronization, security monitoring). Trace: [Article_11 §3]

feature.name: Reify_Dependencies
feature.description: Make inter‑model data flows explicit in the federation model. Trace: [Article_11 §3]

feature.name: Coordinate_Behaviors
feature.description: Orchestrate execution of models according to the computed plan. Trace: [Article_11 §41]
